specification.description: Bohemian silver mini tote with a canvas body and an easy standard shape, suited to travel styling in warmer seasons.
construction_details: Durable canvas body with bound interior seams
Twin rolled top handles with reinforced attachment points
Open top with a secure internal snap tab
specification.care_instructions: Spot clean with a mild detergent and cool water; reshape while damp and dry flat away from direct sunlight.

quality_adjustments: Synthetic capacity defined as 70% of external volume, rounded down to 0.1 L, to correct impossible generated volume.
